<STRUCT_0001>
In the situation of Definition <REF_0001>, there 
is an associated <EMPHOPEN_0001>category of dotted arrows<EMPHCLOSE_0001>. 
This category is a groupoid. It may depend on <MATH_0001> in general. 
The next two lemmas say that categories of dotted arrows 
are well-behaved with respect to base change and composition for <MATH_0002>.
